slides.title: Requirements & Availability
steps: Applies to storefronts with at least one active merchant-managed retail location.
Qualifying locations list their capabilities in the discovery profile.

slides.title: Core Capabilities
features: Exposes search and lookup tools at the storefront Model Context Protocol endpoint.
Filter retail stores by name, city, or explicit distance relations.
Check product variant availability across specific physical store locations.

slides.title: Developer Guidelines
cards: Declare required capabilities in agent profiles before invoking tools.
Send distance center only from coordinates explicitly shared by the buyer.
Confirm availability and fulfillment options in cart and checkout.
